title: Metabolic activation of tachysterol(3) to biologically active hydroxyderivatives that act on VDR, AhR, LXRs, and PPARgamma receptors.
authors: Slominski, Andrzej T; Kim, Tae-Kang; Slominski, Radomir M; Song, Yuwei; Janjetovic, Zorica; Podgorska, Ewa; Reddy, Sivani B; Song, Yuhua; Raman, Chander; Tang, Edith K Y; Fabisiak, Adrian; Brzeminski, Pawel; Sicinski, Rafal R; Atigadda, Venkatram; Jetten, Anton M; Holick, Michael F; Tuckey, Robert C
journal: FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究维生素D光产物tachysterol(3)的代谢活化及其羟基衍生物与多种核受体（含VDR、AhR、LXRs、PPARgamma）的结合，虽涉及分子对接和受体配体互作，但核心是代谢物-核受体而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: CYP11A1 and CYP27A1 hydroxylate tachysterol(3) , a photoproduct of previtamin D(3) , producing 20S-hydroxytachysterol(3) [20S(OH)T(3) ] and 25(OH)T(3) , respectively. Both metabolites were detected in the human epidermis and serum. Tachysterol(3) was also detected in human serum at a concentration of 7.3 +/- 2.5 ng/ml. 20S(OH)T(3) and 25(OH)T(3) inhibited the proliferation of epidermal keratinocytes and dermal fibroblasts and stimulated the expression of differentiation and anti-oxidative genes in keratinocytes in a similar manner to 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D(3) [1,25(OH)(2) D(3) ]. They acted on the vitamin D receptor (VDR) as demonstrated by image flow cytometry and the translocation of VDR coupled GFP from the cytoplasm to the nucleus of melanoma cells, as well as by the stimulation of CYP24A1 expression. Functional studies using a human aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) reporter assay system revealed marked activation of AhR by 20S(OH)T(3) , a smaller effect by 25(OH)T(3) , and a minimal effect for their precursor, tachysterol(3) . Tachysterol(3) hydroxyderivatives showed high-affinity binding to the ligan-binding domain (LBD) of the liver X receptor (LXR) alpha and beta, and the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) in LanthaScreen TR-FRET coactivator assays. Molecular docking using crystal structures of the LBDs of VDR, AhR, LXRs, and PPARgamma revealed high docking scores for 20S(OH)T(3) and 25(OH)T(3) , comparable to their natural ligands. The scores for the non-genomic-binding site of the VDR were very low indicating a lack of interaction with tachysterol(3) ligands. Our identification of endogenous production of 20S(OH)T(3) and 25(OH)T(3) that are biologically active and interact with VDR, AhR, LXRs, and PPARgamma, provides a new understanding of the biological function of tachysterol(3) .
abstract_zh: CYP11A1和CYP27A1羟基化速甾醇(3)（tachysterol(3)），一种前维生素D(3)的光产物，分别生成20S-羟基速甾醇(3) [20S(OH)T(3)]和25(OH)T(3)。这两种代谢物均在人表皮和血清中检测到。速甾醇(3)也在人血清中检测到，浓度为7.3 ± 2.5 ng/ml。20S(OH)T(3)和25(OH)T(3)抑制表皮角质形成细胞和真皮成纤维细胞的增殖，并以类似于1,25-二羟基维生素D(3) [1,25(OH)₂D(3)]的方式刺激角质形成细胞中分化和抗氧化基因的表达。它们作用于维生素D受体（VDR），这通过图像流式细胞术和VDR偶联GFP从细胞质向黑色素瘤细胞核的转位，以及CYP24A1表达的刺激得以证实。使用人芳香烃受体（AhR）报告基因检测系统的功能研究表明，20S(OH)T(3)显著激活AhR，25(OH)T(3)效果较小，而其前体速甾醇(3)效果微弱。速甾醇(3)羟基衍生物在LanthaScreen TR-FRET共激活因子检测中显示出对肝X受体（LXR）α和β以及过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARγ）配体结合域（LBD）的高亲和力结合。使用VDR、AhR、LXRs和PPARγ的LBD晶体结构进行分子对接，显示20S(OH)T(3)和25(OH)T(3)具有高对接分数，与其天然配体相当。VDR非基因组结合位点的分数非常低，表明与速甾醇(3)配体缺乏相互作用。我们鉴定出内源性产生的20S(OH)T(3)和25(OH)T(3)具有生物活性，并与VDR、AhR、LXRs和PPARγ相互作用，这为速甾醇(3)的生物学功能提供了新的理解。
